Subject: Brenvale Living Communities - Quote in Progress

Hi Priya,

Thanks for the submission on Brenvale Living Communities! I've received the application, statement of values, and loss runs—everything looks good to move forward.

Thanks for thinking of us on this one!

Best regards,
[Underwriter name]
